title: The Twelve Concepts for World Service (Short Form), SMF-114
author: W., Bill (Alcoholics Anonymous World Services)
edition_note: Short form as posted by A.A.W.S.; the Concepts were adopted in 1962.
what_it_supports: Chapter 10 and the primer's Tradition 9 entry. It is the fellowship's most extended statement on service structure and the strongest place to look for a rule about the size of a rotating pool.
the_finding: It does not state one. Concept 4, the Right of Participation, asks for voting representation in reasonable proportion to the responsibility each element discharges. That is a proportionality principle, but it proportions voting weight to responsibility, not the size of a rotating pool to the size of the group. The model's rotation result therefore remains something A.A. does not say, now checked against the fellowship's fullest treatment rather than only against Tradition 9 and the 1953 commentary.
